ticket.title: Implement the Two-Factor Verification Page (TOTP)
ticket.text:
Implement the Two-Factor Verification Page (TOTP)

Implement the second-factor verification screen displayed after successful username/password authentication.

Scope

- Create the verification page.
- Support multiple verification methods (e.g. TOTP and email verification).
- Implement a reusable verification code input component using Carbon styling.

understanding.intent: Provide a second-factor verification screen after login where users can enter a verification code via TOTP or email.

criteria.text: Display the second-factor verification page after successful username and password authentication.
criteria.quote: Implement the second-factor verification screen displayed after successful username/password authentication.

criteria.text: Allow the user to use multiple verification methods, including TOTP and email verification.
criteria.quote: Support multiple verification methods (e.g. TOTP and email verification).

criteria.text: Provide a reusable verification code input component styled with Carbon.
criteria.quote: Implement a reusable verification code input component using Carbon styling.

questions: How does the user switch between or select available verification methods (e.g., TOTP vs email)?
What are the code length and formatting requirements for the verification code input component?
What error message is displayed when an invalid or expired code is entered?
Where is the user redirected upon successful code verification?
"verification page" does not exist in the code: is it a new screen to be built, and where should it appear?
"username/password authentication" was not found in the code: which existing screen is meant?

risks.detail: The ticket lists high-level scope items without detailing the UI layout, error handling, resend functionality, or redirection upon successful verification.
